value: National Energy Technology Laboratory (2022). Industrial CO2 Capture Retrofit Database (IND CCRD), public workbook Revision 59, 20 December 2022. DOE/NETL-2022/3319. Pittsburgh, PA: U.S. Department of Energy. OSTI 1887588.
2018_USD: the workbook's default cost year basis (User Input 'Cost Year Basis'); the tool can re-escalate but the saved results are 2018.

A macro-enabled model (.xlsm) that sizes and costs CO2 capture retrofits for every US ammonia, cement, ethanol, hydrogen and natural-gas-processing facility in EPA GHGRP. Main file: the Summary sheet's unit-average results of the default run, converted to per-tonne figures with the formula shown. Sidecars (not loaded): the full Summary block (fleet totals and unit averages), the reference cases the scaling is anchored to (from NETL 'Cost of Capturing CO2 from Industrial Sources', Rev. 2, 2014, with the ammonia reformer-flue-gas unit added), and the cost-scaling exponents and O&M factors. Values are read from the cached results; the macros were not run. Found filed under gov-usa/lbnl with its download name 201-003-044_IND_CCRD_PublicRev59_20221220.xlsm and moved to gov-usa/netl on 2026-09-23. On 2026-09-25 the unit-average cost of CO2 captured (excluding T&S) for the five products moved from _summary to the main file as cost-levelized.
